title: "You're on a bicycle with a little motor": Benefits and Challenges of Using AI Code Assistants
measured_outcome_verified: Developer experiences, perceived benefits, challenges, and coping strategies when using AI code assistants.
supporting_evidence: The study is based on interviews with 14 software developers about daily experiences using AI code assistants.
verification_notes: No observed productivity/effort outcome with an identifiable workflow boundary.

title: A Large-Scale Survey on the Usability of AI Programming Assistants: Successes and Challenges
measured_outcome_verified: Developer-reported usability, motivations, successful use cases, and challenges with AI programming assistants.
supporting_evidence: Claims about finishing tasks quickly and reducing keystrokes are reported motivations rather than directly observed task-time outcomes.
verification_notes: Perceived usability/productivity is insufficient for workflow-boundary coding.

title: AI-Assisted Code Authoring at Scale: Fine-Tuning, Deploying, and Mixed Methods Evaluation
measured_outcome_verified: Observed use and contribution of the CodeCompose code-authoring system.
measurement_unit_verified: Hidden-line reproduction accuracy, share of authored code coming directly from CodeCompose, usage/adoption metrics, and feedback.
supporting_evidence: CodeCompose was deployed to thousands of developers; the paper reports that a measurable share of authored code comes directly from the assistant and evaluates suggestion-generation accuracy.
verification_notes: B1 because the measured behavioral output concerns local code authoring/suggestion use rather than completion of an end-to-end task.

title: AI-Tutoring in Software Engineering Education
An Industry Case Study on Adoption of AI-based Programming Assistants
measured_outcome_verified: Practitioner adoption, usage patterns, motivations, and perceived benefits/challenges of AI programming assistants.
supporting_evidence: The study asks how practitioners perceive and use AI tools; reported acceleration of searching, typing, and syntax recall is survey-based rather than an observed effort outcome.

title: Ansible Lightspeed: A Code Generation Service for IT Automation
measured_outcome_verified: Utility and usage of the Ansible Lightspeed code-generation service.
measurement_unit_verified: User acceptance, rejected suggestions, utilization, retention, and sentiment indicators.
supporting_evidence: The evaluation focuses on user acceptance, retention, rejected suggestions, and sentiments among real users.
verification_notes: Usage/adoption telemetry does not establish a productivity or effort boundary under the current coding protocol.

title: Beyond Code Generation: An Observational Study of ChatGPT Usage in Software Engineering Practice

How ChatGPT shapes the future labour market situation of software engineers: A Finnish Delphi study

supporting_evidence: The study forecasts changes in software-engineering work and labour markets rather than measuring developer workflow effort.
verification_notes: Prospective expert judgment is outside the empirical boundary analysis.

title: How Far Are We? The Triumphs and Trials of Generative AI in Learning Software Engineering
Navigating the Complexity of Generative AI Adoption in Software Engineering—RCR Report
measured_outcome_verified: Factors affecting GenAI adoption and integration into software-engineering workflows.
measurement_unit_verified: Survey constructs and PLS-SEM relationships in an adoption framework.
supporting_evidence: The RCR report concerns adoption factors, perceived usefulness, compatibility, social influences, and organizational factors.
verification_notes: No measured productivity/effort outcome with an identifiable boundary.

title: The Role of Generative AI in Software Development Productivity: A Pilot Case Study
Trade-offs for Substituting a Human with an Agent in a Pair Programming Context: The Good, the Bad, and the Ugly
Using an LLM to Help With Code Understanding
What drives the corporate payoffs of using generative artificial intelligence?
measured_outcome_verified: Enterprise-level GenAI productivity gains across multiple business functions.
measurement_unit_verified: Throughput time, unit cost, task effectiveness, and related enterprise productivity measures.
supporting_evidence: The analysis combines GenAI use cases across content production, coding, customer acquisition, marketing/sales, and customer service.
verification_notes: Productivity is measured, but the software-development workflow boundary for the coding component cannot be identified from the reported aggregate measures.

title: “Will I be replaced?” Assessing ChatGPT's effect on software development and programmer perceptions of AI tools
measured_outcome_verified: ChatGPT code-generation effectiveness on LeetCode problems and programmer perceptions of AI tools.
measurement_unit_verified: Automated code-problem performance plus questionnaire responses.
supporting_evidence: Study 1 evaluates ChatGPT itself on 180 coding problems; Study 2 surveys 99 programmers about capabilities, trust, perceived productivity, and job-security concerns.
verification_notes: Model-only performance is not developer effort, while human productivity evidence is perceptual.
